ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter and central base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions across both lobes. Distinctive low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated along the distal tips and the entire trailing edge. A specific, high-contrast black geometric marking is centered at the inferior-medial junction, exhibiting a vertically-oriented, jagged structure.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees and significant depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations concentrated on the distal outer tips. The trailing edge between the central notch and the tips shows irregular, low-frequency pixel variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory from the median notch extending towards the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, textured pixel clusters localized on the far distal tips of both lobes, suggesting high-contrast surface irregularities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A highly distinctive, complex black mark at the center-bottom of the fluke, resembling a vertical series of three horizontal strokes or a stylized 'E' shape.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized cluster of small, low-contrast yellowish-brown spots on the left lobe adjacent to the central ridge.
